def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # trio: non-zero cells in one row
    trio=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=0]
    from collections import defaultdict
    rows=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c,v in trio: rows[r].append((c,v))
    trio_row=max(rows,key=lambda r:len(rows[r]))
    strays=[(r,c,v) for r,c,v in trio if r!=trio_row]
    for c0,v in rows[trio_row]:
        end=[(r,c) for r,c,x in strays if x==v]
        if end:
            r1,c1=end[0]
            for r in range(r1+1): out[r][c0]=v
            for c in range(min(c0,c1),max(c0,c1)+1): out[r1][c]=v
        else:
            for r in range(h): out[r][c0]=v
    return out
